translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

content: Ukpa̱ u Liꞌazaru
Kain ka te, maɓa̱la̱ ma ka̱na̱i vuma roku uza ɗa a ka isa̱ Liꞌazaru, uza ɗa wa rongo a ilyuci i Batani n ataku a ne Meri n Marta.
Meri na vi, uza ɗa vangu u ne wa̱ri n maɓa̱la̱ mi, aya uza ɗa u tuwa̱i u tsungi manivi ma magula̱ni a aꞌene a Asheku, aku u yansai a ɗa n kenji ka ne.
Pini nala, Meri n Marta a suki uza roku u ba u tonuko Yesu, “Asheku, uza ɗa va ciga vi, maɓa̱la̱ ma ka̱na̱ yi ɗe.”
An Yesu panai nala, u danai, “Maɓa̱la̱ ma nala ma kotso a ukpa̱ wa. Nala u gita̱ ta̱ tsa̱ra̱ a tuko tsupige a asu u Kashila̱, na̱ mpa Maku ma Kashila̱, n wushi tsupige adama a nala.”
Yesu wa ciga ta̱ Marta n aꞌangu a ne.
Shegai an u panai a da maɓa̱la̱ ma ka̱na̱ ta̱ Liꞌazaru, aku u doki u shamgbai pini a asu u ɗa wa̱ri vi aꞌayin a re.
Aku u tonukoi atoni a ne, “Tsu gonoi a Yahuda.”
Atoni yi a danai, “Kawenishiki, kotsu u ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ an azapige a aza a Yahuda a ka ciga a vara̱sa vu a wuna vu wa. Ndya i zuwai va ciga vu doku vu gono ɗe?”
U wushuki, “Uliva̱ dem wa̱ ta̱ n ulapa uwule kupa n ure. Aꞌayin a ɗa baci dem katyashi ka̱ri la, ama a ka wala ta̱ kpam a ka ta̱ɗa̱tsa̱ wa. A ka wene ta̱ kpaci aꞌa̱ ta̱ n katyashi ka likimba u na.
Shegai a wala baci n karimbi, a ka ta̱ɗa̱tsa̱ ta̱, kpaci aꞌa̱ n katyashi wa.”
Aku u tonuko le, “Kaje ka tsunu Liꞌazaru aya pini wa lavuta, nte ma bana ɗe tsa̱ra̱ n ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ yi.”
Aku atoni yi a danai, “Asheku, alavu a ɗa yi baci, wa ta̱na̱ ta̱!”
Ele n a dani ko alavu a maci a ɗa Yesu tonuko le wa lavuta, shegai Yesu tonuko ɗa wa tonuko le Liꞌazaru kuwa̱ ɗe.
Aku u wutumkpa̱ le a kateshe, u danai, “Liꞌazaru kuwa̱ ɗe.
Shegai n pana ta̱ kayanyan an bawu ma̱ri ɗe. Adama a nala, ya rotsongusu ta̱ i wushuku na̱ mpa. Tuwa̱i tsu banai ara ne gogo‑na.”
Aku katoni ka roku Toma (uza ɗa a ka isa̱ “Mapeshe”) u tonukoi aza ɗa a buwai, “Tsu soki kawenishiki ki gba̱ tsunu, tsa̱ra̱ tsu kuwa̱ ɗe kaɓolo n eyi!”
Yesu n Meri n Marta
An Yesu rawai evu, u cinai cina a ciɗa̱ngu ɗe Liꞌazaru n aꞌayin a nishi.
Batani n Urishelima aꞌa̱ ta̱ evu evu, evu n mel u re ɗa.
Adama a nala, aza a Yahuda ushani a bansa ta̱ idyani i ukpa̱ ara Marta n Meri adama a ukpa̱ u vangu u le.
An Marta panai a da Yesu wa tuwa̱, aku u banai u gawunsai n eyi, shegai Meri shamgbai pini a kuwa.
Marta tonukoi Yesu, “Asheku, a da baci va̱ri pini, vangu u va̱ wa̱ri wa kuwa̱ wa.
Shegai ko n gogo‑na n reve ta̱ Kashila̱ ka na̱ka̱ vu ta̱ ili iꞌya baci dem vu folo yi.”
U danai, “Vangu u vunu wa ꞌya̱nga̱ ta̱ u yain kpam uma.”
Marta wushuki, “N reve ta̱ an wa ꞌya̱nga̱ kain ka makorishi, Kashila̱ ka ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ baci gba̱ akushe.”
U wushunku yi, “Mpa n tsu ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ ukpa̱, mpa kpam uma. Aza ɗa baci a wushuki na̱ mpa, ko a kuwa̱ baci a ka ꞌya̱nga̱ ta̱.
Uza ɗa wa̱ri n uma kpam u wushuki na̱ mpa, wa kuwa̱ wa. Marta, vu wushuku wa̱?”
U danai, “N wushuku ta̱, Asheku. Aɗa Kawauwi, Maku ma Kashila̱, uza ɗa wa tuwa̱ a likimba vi.”
Yesu sa̱i
An Marta danai nala, aku u gonoi u ba u tonukoi vangu u ne Meri koshi, u danai, “Kawenishiki ki ka rawa ɗe, kpam aɗa wa wecike.”
An Meri panai nala, aku u ꞌya̱nga̱i gogo wa bana ara Yesu.
Kotsu u rawa a ilyuci yi wa, nte u buwai ve ɗe a asu u ɗa Marta gawunsai n eyi.
Ama ushani a tuwa̱ le ta̱ uwene, shegai an a wenei Meri wuta̱i a kuwa ki gogo, aku a yawunsai nte wa bana ɗe a asu u kasaun vi tsa̱ra̱ u sa̱i. Aku a tono yi.
Meri vi u banai a asu u ɗa Yesu wa̱ri. An u wene yi, aku u kuɗa̱ngi a kapala ka ne u danai, “Asheku, a da baci va̱ri pini na, vangu u va̱ wa̱ri wa kuwa̱ wa.”
U wene yi wa sa̱, ama ɗa aꞌa̱ri kaɓolo n eyi dem a ka sa̱, aku u dambulai cika.
U wece le, “Nte i ciɗa̱ngu yi?” A wushunku yi, “Asheku, tuwa̱ vu wene asu vi.”
Aku Yesu dem u sa̱i.
Ama ɗa aꞌa̱ri kushani pini evu a danai, “I wene ta̱ tyoku ɗa wa ciga Liꞌazaru cika.”
Shegai aza roku a le a danai, “U zuwa ta̱ karumba̱ ka wenei. Wa̱ri u gan ta̱ u ɓishinka Liꞌazaru ukuwa̱.”
Yesu ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱i Liꞌazaru a ukpa̱
Eyi pini a kadambula ki, aku u banai a asu u kasaun vi. Kasaun ki tani kaaɓuru ka, kpam a kimba̱ ta̱ ka n katali ka roku a utsutsu vi.
Aku u tonuko le, “Gindala̱kpai katali ki a ikengi.” Shegai Marta danai, “Asheku, vu reve ta̱ Liꞌazaru kuwa̱ ɗe aꞌayin a nishi, ka̱wa̱n ka yan ta̱ pini.”
Yesu tonuko yi, “Vu a̱sa̱nsa̱ an n tonuko vu, ‘Vu wushuku baci va wene ta̱ tsupige tsu Kashila̱’?”
Aku a gindala̱kpai katali ki a ikengi. U weɓelei zuba u danai, “Tata, n cikpa vu ta̱ an vu pana̱ka mu.
N reve ta̱ vu tsu pana̱ka mu ta̱ maco, shegai n dana ta̱ nala adama a ama ɗa a kyawan mu na vi. Ma ciga ta̱ a wushuku an aɗa vu suku mu.”
An u kotsoi kavasu, aku u salai, “Liꞌazaru, wuta̱!”
Aku u wuta̱i. Akere n aꞌene a ne ucaci n aminya a eri, a cacai kpam upetiwaꞌeshi u ne n kunya.Liꞌazaru wuta̱i a kasaun Aku Yesu danai, “Surukpa ni i a̱sa̱ka̱ yi u wala.”
A sheshei tsa̱ra̱ a wuna Yesu
Ama ushani a ɗa a tuwa̱i tsa̱ra̱ a wene Meri vi a wenei ili iꞌya Yesu yain, aku a wushuki n eyi.
Aza roku a le a banai a asu u Afarishi a tonuko le ili iꞌya Yesu yain.
Aku aɗara̱kpi a pige n Afarishi a ɓolomgbonoi Asheshi a Pige a asu u te, a danai, “Ndya tsa yan? Vuma u na wa yansa ta̱ ikunesavu ushani.
Tsu a̱sa̱ka̱ yi baci u lyai kapala n uyansa ili i na yi, ya dem wa wushuku ta̱ n eyi. Aku asoje a aza a Roma a tuwa̱ a wacinsa Kuwa ku Kashila̱ ku tsunu n uyamba u tsunu.”
Uza roku a asuvu a Asheshi a Pige yi; wata, Kayafa, uza ɗa wa̱ri Magono ma Aɗara̱kpi a kayen ki, u danai, “Eɗa̱ i reve ili iꞌya iꞌa̱ri pini wa!
Niɗa ya a̱sa̱ka̱ uyamba gba̱ u kuwa̱? Wa la ta̱ tsulobo uza u te u na vi u kuwa̱ n u ɗa a ama gba̱ a ka kuwa̱.”

Uyawunsa u na vi a katakasuvu ka Kayafa ka u wuta̱i wa. Shegai an wa̱ri Magono ma Aɗara̱kpi a kayen ka nala ki ɗa i zuwai wa yan kadyanshi ka ili iꞌya ya tuwa̱ ya gita̱: Dana ɗa wa dana Yesu wa kuwa̱ ta̱ adama a aza a Yahuda.
Adama a unyushi u aza a Yahuda a ɗa koshi Yesu wa kuwa̱ wa. Wa kuwa̱ ta̱ tsa̱ra̱ u ɓolomgbono ama a Kashila̱ a ɗa a wacinsai a asuvu a likimba.
Kain ka nala ki ka azapige a aza a Yahuda a gita̱i ufoɓuso tyoku ɗa a ka wuna Yesu.
Adama a nala, Yesu doku u wala a kateshe a Yahuda wa, aku u a̱sa̱ka̱i Urishelima. U lazai ubana a ilyuci i Ifuramu, iꞌya iꞌa̱ri a ikengi i kakamba, aku u dusuki ɗe n atoni a ne.
An a yain evu n Abiki a Upasamgbana, aku ama ushani aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri a ilyuci i kenu kenu a lazai ubana a Urishelima kahu abiki yi, tsa̱ra̱ a wulukpe kaci ka le tyoku ɗa Mele ma danai a yansa.
A ka ciga a wene Yesu, ele pini a Kuwa ku Kashila̱ ki, aku a ka wecemgbene, “Ndya i wenei? Wa tuwa̱ gba̱m a asu u abiki vi?”
Aɗara̱kpi a pige n Afarishi yi a tonukoi ama, uza ɗa baci dem u wenei Yesu, u tonuko le, kotsu a ka̱na̱ yi.
